references.text: Moses' face shone after being on the mountain with God, parallel to Jesus' transfiguration on the mountain.
Jesus instructs not to tell anyone about the miracles until the time is right, similar to the instruction not to speak about the transfiguration.
Jesus gives a similar instruction after the transfiguration in Mark.
A similar event where Jesus instructs them not to tell what they have seen until he has risen from the dead.
